reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for layered long-term memory that captures conversations, distills them into structured memory, retrieves relevant entries, and injects them into agent context, with optional embedding-based search.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供分层长期记忆，自动捕获并蒸馏对话内容，在后续步骤中检索和注入相关记忆。
summaries.en: Provides layered long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness by capturing and distilling conversations, then retrieving and injecting relevant memories into later agent steps.

capabilities: Captures and persistently stores conversation-derived memories
Uses an LLM to extract, consolidate, and summarize memories
Automatically retrieves and injects relevant memories into agent context
Provides memory search and scene-reading tools
Supports optional remote embeddings services and optional local embedding models
